minutes_text:
CITY OF SOUTH GATE
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY, JULY 26, 2022

CALL TO ORDER  Al Rios, Mayor called a Special City Council meeting to order at 5:31
  p.m.

ROLL CALL  Yodit Glaze, City Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor Al Rios, Vice Mayor Maria del Pilar Avalos, Council Member
  Denise Diaz, and Council Member Gil Hurtado; Interim City Manager
  Chris Jeffers, City Attorney Raul F. Salinas

ABSENT  Council Member Maria Davila, and City Treasurer Gregory Martinez

CLOSED SESSION  The Council Members recessed into Closed Session at 5:33 p.m. and
  reconvened at 6:29 p.m. with four (4) Members of Council present. City
  Attorney Salinas reported the following:

  1.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - PENDING LITIGATION
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(a), 54954.9(b)(3)(C)

  a.  Raymond Celmer v. City of South Gate (WCAB)
  b.  Beatriz Sereno v. City of South Gate
  c.  In Re Pacific Hydrotech Corporation

  Item 1(a) involves a claim by a former retired employee of the City of
  South Gate injured in the course of performing duties. There was a case
  pending before the Workers' Compensation Appeals Board. The matter
  was handled by an outside lawyer that specializes in these matters. There
  was a presentation made and a request to settle the case. The City Council
  on a motion made by Council Member Hurtado and seconded by Vice
  Mayor Avalos and on a vote of 4-0, approved to resolve that case.

  Item 1(b) is a claim filed by someone who tripped on a city's sidewalk.
  The City Council received a presentation by staff concerning that claim,
  and upon completion of that presentation, the City Council moved to deny
  the claim. The motion was made by Council Member Hurtado and
  seconded by Council Member Diaz. The vote was 4-0.

  Item 1(c) is a threat of litigation involving a contractor performing
  services on behalf of the city on a work of public improvement. The City
  Council received a presentation by city staff regarding a proposed
  settlement of that dispute and upon completion of that presentation by
  staff there was a motion made by Council Member Hurtado and seconded
   SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES OF JULY 26, 2022

  by Mayor Rios, and on a vote of 4-0, the City Council gave direction to
  move forward with a settlement provided that the agreement met the
  satisfaction of the City Attorney as to form and that the dollar amounts
  would not increase.

ADJOURNMENT  Council Member Hurtado adjourned the meeting at 6:30 p.m. and
  seconded Vice Mayor Avalos.

PASSED and APPROVED this 27th day of September 2022.

  ATTEST:

Al Rios, Mayor  Yodit I e, City Clerk
